_note: Provider settings live here, not in the simulation logic. `status`: 'in-use' = the path the app used before this registry existed; 'untested' = request shape built from public documentation, never run against the real service (CORS preflight to the endpoint was checked on 2026-10-17, no key used). Model names are recommendations a teacher can change; they are not pedagogically or clinically validated.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.notes: A free-plan key reportedly works only with one specific model (per the API-key wizard); the teacher must choose it.

providers.name: xAI (Grok)
providers.notes: Documentation names the Responses API as the preferred interface.

providers.name: Groq
providers.notes: Not xAI's Grok. Free plan exists; limits unverified.

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.notes: OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Compatibility with this app's structured output is unverified. Free-tier content may be used by Google to improve products.

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.notes: Routes to many models; free models have a low daily request limit.

providers.name: Mistral AI
providers.notes: Free experiment plan may use requests for model training and requires phone verification.
